notes: Floating layers get a real fill: one --color-overlay token (base background at 88% dark, 92% light) and one .floating-surface class (overlay fill, hairline, 24px blur, 12px on the animating popover/modal/toast/picker/command variants) replace the bg-content/10 washes on Popover, Modal, ApprovalToasts, AgentDetail, FilePicker, SymbolPicker, CommandPopover and both tooltips, so a model picker or dialog over a long transcript reads at full contrast in both themes; reduced transparency drops the blur and goes solid
